column5: text
Right, you lot, eyes front! Look left, look right, then double over to my flag.
Over the start line, sprint for the ditch, jump it, and over that wall. Move yourself!
Wire! Get down on your belly and crawl under it. Then kneel behind the sandbags.
No bridge for you, lad. Through the water, and out the far side.
The range, lad. Sten from the hip, rifle through the sights. Reload, and change weapons. Make every round count.
Grenades. Draw a Mills bomb and lob it into the pit. Into the pit, mind, not at your feet.
The PIAT. Heavy, slow, and it stops a tank. Pick it up, aim high, and put a bomb into that hulk.
You've caught one, lad. Only a drill, but let's see you put on a field dressing.
Against the clock, lad. Over the line, drop the defenders, take the bridge, and send Ham and Jam on the wireless.
Not bad for a first parade. Eyes front, you'll do. Now the assault course.
Over the wall and still breathing. Smartish now, lad, the wire is next.
Crawled like a proper soldier. Mud suits you, lad. On to the canal.
Wet through, but you made it. Jerry won't be impressed, mind. On to the range.
Good shooting. Sten, rifle and a tidy reload. Now for the grenades.
In the pit, and not at your feet. Well done, lad. Now the PIAT.
That hulk won't be going anywhere. Nicely done. Now, a field dressing for you.
Patched up and fit for duty. Jerry won't know what hit him. On to the bridge, and double!
Eyes front, lad! Look around, then double over to my flag. I haven't got all day.
Sprint, lad, sprint! Over the start line, jump the ditch, then up and over that wall.
Down on your belly, lad! Crawl under the wire, then kneel behind the sandbags.
In you go. Swim across and climb out on the far bank. The water won't bite.
Sten from the hip, rifle through the sights, then reload and change weapons. Get on with it!
Take out the Mills bomb and lob it into the pit. Not at your feet, lad!
Pick up the PIAT, aim high and hit that tank. It won't shoot itself.
You're bleeding, lad. Put on your field dressing, and do it smartish.
Clock's ticking! Drop the defenders, take the bridge, and send Ham and Jam on the wireless.
Recruit! Bootcamp at Countess Wear before you meet Jerry, or are you going straight in?
Skipping that one, lad? Jerry won't skip you. On to the next.
That's bootcamp done, lad. You'll do. Now go and show Jerry what you've learned. Dismissed!
